title: Two traders swap pounds for dollars
summary: Alice sells 1,000 GBP to Bob for 1,270 USD, settled in one transaction.

steps.title: Make Alice
steps.text: Every action on a blockchain is signed by a key. This step creates Alice's key, which is how she proves she is Alice.

steps.title: Make Bob
steps.text: Bob gets his own key too, so he can act separately from Alice.

steps.title: Start a chain
steps.text: A chain is a private practice network, like a sandbox. This makes a fresh one and gives Alice and Bob some of its native coin to pay fees.

steps.title: Create the pound token
steps.text: A token is a made-up currency tracked by a program on the chain. Alice creates pounds (GBP, two decimal places) and receives all one million of them.

steps.title: Create the dollar token
steps.text: Bob creates dollars (USD, six decimal places) and receives all one million of them.

steps.title: Put up a swap
steps.text: A swap is a small shared program that holds one trader's tokens until another trader accepts the deal. Alice puts one on the chain.

steps.title: Alice allows the swap to move her pounds
steps.text: Before a program can move your tokens, you must say it may, and how many. Alice allows the swap to take up to 1,000 of her pounds.

steps.title: Alice offers 1,000 pounds for 1,270 dollars
steps.text: Alice posts her deal. The swap takes her 1,000 pounds and holds them safely (this is called escrow) until someone accepts.

steps.title: Bob allows the swap to move his dollars
steps.text: Bob must also give permission, for up to 1,270 of his dollars, so the swap can pay Alice on his behalf.

steps.title: Bob accepts the offer
steps.text: Bob accepts. In one step the swap sends Alice's 1,000 pounds to Bob and Bob's 1,270 dollars to Alice. Either both moves happen or neither does.

steps.title: See what happened
steps.text: Here is the record of the swap: what was sent, what moved, and who ended up with what.
